summary: Add opt-in named Installer source commit wakes and distinct post-publication wakes on the existing IVM Publisher.

replay.detail: No admission, replay, source capture, prepared publication or retained-root certification is supplied or changed.

schema.detail: No schema, index, trigger, journal or persisted counter is created. Explicit attachment reads existing Installer metadata.

rules.detail: No authority, retention, checkpoint, digest or read-coverage rules change.

compatibility.detail: The library adds Notice::Source with committed/publication/invalidation wake types. Exhaustive consumers must adapt. Existing Publisher::attach retains its frontier query and behavior; attach_with_sources is opt-in and requires complete owner-qualified sources. No native production activation is included.

downtime.detail: Library-only source change; no deployment or restart behavior is implemented.

manual.detail: An adopting owner explicitly configures at most sixteen bounded source identities after schema/capture setup and sends publication wakes only after guarded AfterCommit cache swap. No production adopter is installed by this change.

recovery.detail: Named-source schema/identity changes invalidate the wake scope and require explicit owner-reviewed reattachment. Wake tokens do not restore availability, clear a fence or certify historical namespace retention. No production recovery implementation is included.
